stories.title: Netanyahu to meet Trump in a first encounter since the Iran war began
stories.description: The meeting comes as both face pressures at home. Netanyahu is up for reelection, embattled in part due to his deteriorating relationship with Trump. Trump is under pressure to end an unpopular war.

stories.title: Trump says Iran war talks taking place during lull in strikes
stories.description: The US president says "there is a good chance that something could happen", as Iran denies direct talks are taking place.

stories.title: As the US pauses the war with Iran, is Trump really running out of weapons?
stories.description: The US has fired thousands of hard-to-replace missiles during its war with Iran. We unpack whether its "arsenal of freedom" is perilously low.

stories.title: More than 600 US military service members injured since Iran War began in February
stories.description: The latest figure includes casualties from Operation Fury and a new category called "Overseas Operations".

stories.title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
stories.description: The US says attacks on Iran have been halted to give "talks some space", raising hopes of a resolution to the conflict.

stories.description: Iran has reacted with fury to the assault on the vessel, with Tehran's foreign minister saying it "cannot go unanswered".

stories.title: US and Iran pause strikes for third night to make space for talks, US ambassador says
stories.description: Neither the US nor Iran have launched attacks in the last three nights, after almost two weeks of tit-for-tat strikes risked derailing talks to permanently end the war.

stories.title: Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump

stories.title: US signs landmark nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia
stories.description: The US Department of Energy says the "peaceful" co-operation agreement will give US firms "great access" to the Saudi nuclear energy programme.

stories.title: Iran missiles target US forces in Jordan after a five-day pause in war
